entities.summary: Jane Christine Walerud Boreta is a Sweden-based entrepreneur and investor. She has been involved in over 15 startups since the early 2000s, including Klarna, Bluetail, Tobii Technology, Teclo Networks, and GraphMaTech. She is member of The Swedish Government Innovation Council.
